contracts.docstring: Original owner selection with no shell commands, caller credentials, namespace identities or fabricated task IDs.
Expose only the configured server and account label for deliberate owner selection, without credentials, host secret paths or network effects.
An explicit administrative effect scope; adoption cannot secretly initialize Git and clone cannot provision or reconfigure a remote.
Reject ambiguous effects, unsafe names/refs and credential-bearing URLs before persisting or allocating anything.
Persist bounded original setup intents and directory ownership through the existing SQLite/project-metadata transaction.
Expose complete recorded source intentions and point-in-time observations without peer internals or an implied fresh Git check.
Persist one exact owner intent before any effect; replay returns it, while a reused key with different scope rejects.
Give one actual administrative process owner its own attempt/fence, without a native task or model invocation.
Share original source admission inside an existing transaction so HTTP ownership can be persisted atomically before its first client.
Expose a bounded redacted current issue while retaining the original operation, physical receipts and any partial files for explicit observation.
Withdraw one original source inside either the individual Stop or atomic whole-project Stop admission transaction.
Record stopped only after original local closure, retaining partially written folders and uncertainty instead of asserting a remote effect was undone.
Reuse bounded source metadata transactions while keeping HTTP clients and issued remote effects separate from Git process grants.
Bind the actual source store without creating clients, namespaces or local directories.
Identify this actual host process in its original visible kernel/PID namespace.
Require the original HTTP attempt and database even after its owner admission has been withdrawn.
Prove exact local closure or same-host original process death; neither proves that a remote request stopped.
Allocate one real HTTP attempt; a fresh observer requires original local closure and never inherits permission to POST.
Check original admission before each HTTP request without granting writes to a readonly observation.
Freeze authenticated numeric namespace, explicit visibility and observed name absence before the sole possible creation.
Durably issue exactly the original POST before sending bytes; an ambiguous response cannot reset this one-way boundary.
Record actual controller closure only for its own original local client, even after Stop withdrew admission.
Record positive original remote evidence after local closure, preserving uncertainty for missing or foreign results and avoiding a fabricated local registration.
Fixed Forgejo namespace and empty-repository operations over the existing bounded, origin-bound transport.
Resolve selected user or organization by server evidence, never by an org-to-user fallback after an error.
Read exactly the selected canonical name; only HTTP 404 means absence and no read error grants a POST.
Accept only complete positive server evidence of the issued original marker, namespace, visibility and canonical clone origin.
Own the real original HTTP client and immediate local withdrawal, independently of SQLite completion or a nonexistent Git domain.
Capture immutable original lease identity before any network request; attach only this controller's real transport.
Synchronously deny later requests and start closing actual local sockets before Stop waits on metadata.
Drain the original local transport once; server-side work is deliberately outside this closure claim.
Create at most once or observe only, under original source lease and actual HTTP lifetime, retaining issued-write uncertainty after every interruption.
Immutable original administrative lease and actual Git broker or HTTP client, captured before its first effect.
Own actual administrative worker handles without inventing native turns or replaying interrupted writes after restart.
Expose saved phase and actual local worker observation; a stopped local worker never proves remote rollback or fresh Git health.
Persist exact owner intent before scheduling one bounded worker; an original replay returns history and never restarts a stopped or uncertain effect.
Keep executor teardown in its owning task and retain failures as saved uncertainty; raw transport errors and secrets never enter the owner response.
Serve real smart HTTP Git over verified local TLS plus a small controlled Forgejo REST contract; all effect actors are fixture-owned.
Bounded fixture protocol handler; authentication values are never logged or saved as artifacts.
Authenticate by protocol, then execute only this temporary repository or its explicit REST model.
Extend the real private-CA server with fixed user/org namespaces and controlled lost/pending creation replies.
Implement only the documented Forgejo user/org and empty-repository endpoints; expose actual wire effects to assertions.
Use the real owner service and host transport, with isolated fixture credentials instead of any user remote or model.
Real REST writes use the selected owner and visibility; replay and lost-response observation cannot create twice or initialize local Git.
A foreign repository, failed read or mismatching authenticated identity cannot authorize creation in either namespace.
Actual Stop while POST is pending cannot claim rollback; readonly observation can later recover exactly that single original effect.
Cancellation after atomic SQL admission but before the lease returns cannot strand an open client identity or release any HTTP request.
Hold the real committed lease only at its thread-to-event-loop handoff, without replacing its actual admission or receipt.
Remote intent is explicit and credential-free; a clone cannot request a visibility change or use an embedded PAT.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. Relevant new frontend modules and exported helpers also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
